maya: FYI customer escalation — multiple 502s and p99 spikes reported for eu-west pinned tenant. They say traffic shows served from us-west :warning:
liam: grabbing router logs now. initial look shows route decision flipped to us-west with fallback=true and reason=capacity_spike
ops-bot: [alert] region-routing-fallback triggered for tenant=acct_42, route_tag=eu-pinned, fallback_target=us-west at 2026-02-10T09:18:12Z
maya: pasted sample audit lines from customer's logs:
```
request_id=rz_01b2 route=europe-west-1 selected_region=us-west fallback=true reason="backend_capacity_low" user_country=DE
request_id=rz_01b3 route=europe-west-1 selected_region=us-west fallback=true reason="router_cache_miss" user_country=FR
```
sofia: Compliance flagged these as residency exceptions, seeing automated audit entries in our compliance queue. We need full request list for affected window and whether data touched non-EU compute :no_entry_sign:
maya: pulling request ids for window 09:15-09:30 UTC and will attach to support ticket. Also customer reports auth errors (invalid token) intermittently — could be related to retries hitting wrong cluster
liam: root cause: router's route-tag cache eviction policy removed tenant pin during a short autoscale event in eu-west; fallback policy allowed routing to compatible us-west pool. I've patched conservative TTL and added stronger pin enforcement in routing layer, pushing hotfix now.
ajay: rebalanced eu-west capacity to reduce future autoscale churn; increased headroom for pinned tenants. Monitoring p95 for routing decisions.
sofia: we need an official compliance statement for affected tenants: confirm which tenant ids, which requests, and whether any payload persisted outside EU. maya — can you draft immediate note for customers?
maya: drafting now — will include timeline, mitigation, and offer export of audit entries. Also flagging billing check (customer saw extra egress charges)
liam: patch deployed to prod at 09:49 UTC, rolling restart of routing mesh completed. Verifying that new requests respect route_tag. Quick smoke: `curl -H "X-Tenant: acct_42" https://inference.api.redwood/health` returns region=eu-west.
ops-bot: incident auto-ticket created: INC-2026-4475, severity=high
sofia: added compliance review task and privacy team loop-in. Recommend proactive outreach to customers in window.
maya: support note ready, attaching list of request_ids and sample audit CSV in ticket. Customer notified and offered export and credit.
ajay: closing monitoring loop — no further fallbacks in last 20m, latency back to baseline.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-4475 status=resolved at 2026-02-10T09:55:50Z
